source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-exact-match-means-the-token-resolved.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: A token whose matches contain an exact-tier entry returned data — it is not a miss at all, so the whole resolution is filtered out of missResolutions before candidate selection. Only the genuinely missed token is probed here.
